question: How did the lithium content of the NMC622 change after delamination?
rendered: The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials before and after recovery was measured using inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICPOES), and it was found that lithium leaching occurred after recovery, with the Cyrene molecule having two ether groups that attract lithium cation due to its electron-donating nature.
